ROBOCON 2025 Quadruped Robot Challenge

Full-stack R&D for 2025 ROBOCON. Responsible for carbon tube assembly mechanical modeling, force control algorithms, and 3D LiDAR SLAM navigation. Led the team to achieve 30th in Speed, 31st in Obstacle, and 34th in Cross-country among 180+ teams.

How Can It Run Faster? Curriculum Learning and Reward Shaping

During the 2025 season, I worked across mechanical modeling, motion control, and autonomous navigation. The robot combined a carbon-tube structure, force-control algorithms, and 3D LiDAR mapping, earning three National Second Prizes.
